# Kalkio

Kalkio is a free website with 42 calculators and converters. Every tool runs in the visitor's browser - no sign-up, no account, no backend. File converters run fully in the browser and files are never uploaded to a server. Tax, bill and fuel results are estimates; official rates are final.
Contact: sammykhanmalng@gmail.com
